ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the linear function $y=ax+b$ intersects with the graph of the reciprocal function $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k\ne 0$) at points $A(1, -3)$ and $B(m, -1)$. Connect $OA$ and $OB$. What is the area of $\triangle OAB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the intersection point of line AB with the y-axis be C. Then, the coordinates of point C are $(0, -4)$. \\
The area of triangle $OAB$, $S_{\triangle OAB}=S_{\triangle BOC}-S_{\triangle AOC}=\frac{1}{2}\times 4\times 3- \frac{1}{2}\times 4\times 1=\boxed{4}.$
